ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to Gies College of Business majors and Actuarial Science. Seats will be opened to Agricultural Accounting, Finance in Agribusiness, Agricultural Finance, Consumer Economics and Finance majors, and Strategy, Innovation, and Entrepreneurship two weeks after priority registration. PLEASE NOTE THAT EACH INSTRUCTOR HAS SPECIFIC DISCUSSION SECTIONS: for lecture sections “RL”, you must enroll in a discussion sections “RD”. For lecture sections "AL", you must enroll in discussion sections "AD". FOR STUDENTS RECEIVING A RESERVED CLOSED ERROR: There are currently reserved seats for Gies College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions at the end of the first week of class on Friday by 10am. Day1Access course materials cost $150.19. For more information see https://go.illinois.edu/Day1Access.
